ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.20:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels; high-intensity pixels are concentrated at the distal tips while low-intensity pixels dominate the central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white mottled region occupying the distal 25% of the left fluke lobe; smaller, diffused white/grey mottling on the distal 15% of the right fluke lobe; uniform low-intensity black pigmentation across the medial and proximal surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth ratio of roughly 1/6th of the visible vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration across the entire trailing edge; distinct high-amplitude jagged peaks at the tips; one significant deep U-shaped notch visible on the left lobe's trailing edge roughly one-third of the distance from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature sweeping upward and outward from the median notch to the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-relief, high-contrast circular clusters of white/grey pixels corresponding to barnacle colonization localized on the outer terminal margin and superior edge of the left fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical linear pixel disruptions located at the base of the peduncle near the water line; faint, multiple parallel horizontal white lines (rake marks) on the medial section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Substantial notch or missing tissue chunk on the interior trailing edge of the left lobe; heavy biological colonization (barnacles) on the terminal edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular highlights from water spray at the base of the fluke creating pixel occlusion at the peduncle-fluke interface.
